# HomePricePeek

> HomePricePeek

Housing affordability for 51 US states + 35 US cities (deep) and 159 international cities (broad). Anchored to OECD, FHFA, Census ACS, FRED, and national statistics offices.

## Core pages
- [Methodology and data sources](https://homepricepeek.com/methodology/): how every figure is derived, with primary-source citations
- [Cities directory](https://homepricepeek.com/city/): browse every city we cover
- [Rankings](https://homepricepeek.com/rankings/): cities ranked by the key metric
- [Compare](https://homepricepeek.com/compare/): side-by-side comparison
- [About and editorial standards](https://homepricepeek.com/about/): authorship and review policy

## Data
- Primary sources: OECD Housing Prices, US Census Bureau (ACS 5-year), FHFA House Price Index, FRED — Federal Reserve Economic Data
- All figures are derived from these primary sources; see /methodology/ for derivation and vintage.
